paras: Smith's leaf-toed gecko (Hemidactylus smithi) is a species of lizard in the family Gekkonidae. The species is endemic to the Horn of Africa.
The specific name, smithi, is in honor of American physician Arthur Donaldson Smith.
H. smithi is found in eastern Ethiopia and northern Somalia.
The preferred habitat of H. smithi is at altitudes of 630–1,100 m (2,070–3,610 ft).
